newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle hires consultant for restructure.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle hires consultant for restructure.

text.p: Pinnacle Micro Inc said Monday it has hired business consultants Pittiglio Rabin Todd & McGrath (PRTM) to assist in consolidating Pinnacle's research and development, materials management, manufacturing, assembly, test and distribution operations.
Pinnacle said it is undertaking the restructuring to boost efficiencies and lower costs.

Pinnacle said it expects to receive PRTM's recommendatons within "weeks" and to implement some of them beginning early in the fourth quarter. It said it expects to consolidate its manufacturing operations at one location.
